generatedProse.concept-context: In psychology, being critical is one habit you bring to every study you read. You question what a study claims, engage with its method and evidence, and name your moves as you analyse the design, evaluate the sample, and judge how far the findings hold. Across a module, that single practice is what turns reading papers into thinking like a psychologist.
generatedProse.worked-example: Two psychology students read the same study claiming a strong effect. One notes the finding and quotes it as fact. The other brings the three strands together: she questions the claim, sees the sample was small and from one group, weighs it against another study, and judges the effect as promising but not yet settled. Her seminar paper is sharper, because she was critical on purpose rather than in three separate steps.
generatedProse.summary: In psychology, being critical works best as one habit across your reading. You question a study, engage with its method and evidence, name your moves, and reach a judgement about how far its findings hold. The whole practice, repeated study after study, is what builds a critical psychologist.

check.body: A student reads a source, questions what it claims, weighs the evidence against another source, and reaches a reasoned judgement of her own. What does this show?

items.text: Their next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved.
Nothing; feedback comes at the end, so it cannot affect anything that follows.
Only the mark on the first report, which cannot now change.
The deadline for the next report.

feedback.correct: That's right. Using the feedback fed back into the next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved: that is the cycle working.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. Think about what the student changed before the next report, not the old mark or the deadline.
feedback.incorrectFinal: Using the feedback fed back into the student's next round of learning and preparation, which is why the next report improved. The old mark cannot change and the deadline is not part of the cycle; feedback is not the end, it feeds the next turn.

_items.text: The whole critical practice at work: the mindset, active engagement, and the language of weighing and judging together.
_items.feedback: Yes. She brought the mindset, engaged actively, and judged with reasons, all in one go.

_items.text: Passive reading, because she used a source in her work.
_items.feedback: Using a source is not passive in itself. She questioned and judged it.

_items.text: Only analysis, because she broke the argument into parts.
_items.feedback: She did more than analyse. She also weighed the evidence and reached a judgement.

_items.text: Fault-finding, because she disagreed with the source.
_items.feedback: Weighing a source and judging it with reasons is not the same as fault-finding.
